engagement_tiers.audience: Steward asking about the operating concept
engagement_tiers.template: Thank you for naming the real constraint. Cambium begins with what the venture must preserve, then makes the next bounded action reviewable. Which part of the cycle are you testing?

That is a fair challenge. Cambium is an operating concept under active development, not proof of autonomous business operation. The claim we can support here is [specific claim]; [unsupported claim] remains unproven.

engagement_tiers.audience: Safety, legal, financial, or account-specific request
engagement_tiers.response_time: Acknowledge promptly; escalate before substantive reply
engagement_tiers.template: This needs a qualified human review. We have recorded the question and will not infer permission or offer account-specific guidance in this channel.

engagement_tactics.purpose: Help stewards turn vague pressure into an observable viability bound
Examine one choice through evidence, authority, action, and outcome
Normalize pausing or closing work that no longer serves the purpose

data.voice_discipline: PASS — uses preferred vocabulary, avoids autonomy theatre, guaranteed outcomes, and urgency pressure
response_do: Name the user's actual constraint before proposing a framework
Separate verified capability from concept or aspiration
Invite a small reversible next step
Escalate consequential, personal, financial, or legal cases
response_dont: Claim that Cambium runs or saves a business autonomously
Treat engagement as consent for account or provider changes
Use fear of failure as a conversion tactic
Invent customer outcomes, availability, or launch dates
